nodes.name: Get Execution Lock Status From Helper

parameters.jsCode:
return {
  ...$json,
  final_status: 'STOP_READ_ONLY_RECONCILIATION_LOCK_CHECK_COMPLETE',
  next_safe_action: $json.human_review_required ? 'Human review required; remain stopped' : 'Remain stopped; read-only monitoring only',
  hard_stop_enforced: true,
  execution_allowed: false,
  live_order_allowed: false,
  automation_allowed: false,
  lock_acquire_allowed: false,
  lock_release_allowed: false,
  auto_unlock_allowed: false,
  retry_allowed: false,
  forbidden_action_allowed: false
};

const log = $json.safe_reconciliation_log_payload || {};
const current = $json.current_reconciliation || {};
const timestampKst = log.timestamp_kst || new Date().toLocaleString('sv-SE', { timeZone: 'Asia/Seoul', hour12: false }).replace('T', ' ') + ' +09:00';
const summary = {
  timestamp_kst: timestampKst,
  market: log.market || current.market || 'KRW-BTC',
  open_order_exists: log.open_order_exists === true,
  open_order_count: Number(log.open_order_count ?? 0),
  duplicate_order_exists: log.duplicate_order_exists,
  reconciliation_classification: log.reconciliation_classification || $json.reconciliation_classification || 'unknown_stop',
  lock_state: log.lock_state || (($json.execution_lock_status || {}).lock_state) || 'unknown_stop',
  lock_exists: log.lock_exists === true,
  stale_lock: log.stale_lock === true,
  lock_classification: log.lock_classification || $json.lock_classification || 'lock_unknown_stop',
  classification: log.classification || $json.classification || 'readonly_stop',
  blocked_reason: log.blocked_reason || null,
  human_review_required: log.human_review_required === true || $json.human_review_required === true,
  forbidden_endpoint_check: log.forbidden_endpoint_check || 'PASS_NO_FORBIDDEN_ENDPOINT_CALLED',
  secrets_leak_check: log.secrets_leak_check || 'PASS_NO_SECRET_FIELDS_PRESENT',
  next_safe_action: log.next_safe_action || 'remain_stopped'
};
const markdown = [
  '# WF05 Read-Only Lock Integration Summary',
  '',
  `- Timestamp KST: ${summary.timestamp_kst}`,
  `- Market: ${summary.market}`,
  `- Open order exists: ${summary.open_order_exists}`,
  `- Open order count: ${summary.open_order_count}`,
  `- Duplicate order exists: ${summary.duplicate_order_exists}`,
  `- Reconciliation classification: ${summary.reconciliation_classification}`,
  `- Lock state: ${summary.lock_state}`,
  `- Lock exists: ${summary.lock_exists}`,
  `- Stale lock: ${summary.stale_lock}`,
  `- Lock classification: ${summary.lock_classification}`,
  `- Classification: ${summary.classification}`,
  `- Blocked reason: ${summary.blocked_reason}`,
  `- Human review required: ${summary.human_review_required}`,
  `- Forbidden endpoint check: ${summary.forbidden_endpoint_check}`,
  `- Secrets leak check: ${summary.secrets_leak_check}`,
  `- Next safe action: ${summary.next_safe_action}`
].join('\n');
return {
  ...$json,
  operator_summary_ready: true,
  operator_summary_payload: summary,
  operator_summary_markdown: markdown,
  execution_allowed: false,
  live_order_allowed: false,
  automation_allowed: false,
  lock_acquire_attempted: false,
  lock_release_attempted: false,
  auto_unlock_attempted: false,
  retry_attempted: false,
  forbidden_action_allowed: false
};
